title: EventFrame

subscription.description: A subscription's id, chosen by the environment and carried by every subscription message.

sequence.description: The event's sequence in its subscription: the log's global sequence, or for terminals.subscribe the terminal's own output sequence; always equal to event.sequence.
The event's place in the log's global sequence, from 1; for a terminal's output, never logged, its place in the terminal's own.

streamKind.description: The kind of stream the event belongs to: environment, access, session, group, settings; terminal for a terminal's output, which terminals.subscribe carries and the log never holds.

streamVersion.description: The event's place in its own stream, from 1.

type.description: What happened, area.verb in the past tense: pairing.created.

occurredAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

anyOf.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

commandId.description: The command that produced the event; null when none did.

causationId.description: The event that caused this one; null when none did.

correlationId.description: The id every event of one piece of work shares; null when there is none.

kind.description: What caused the event: a client session, a routine, a provider adapter or the environment itself.

id.description: The actor's id within its kind; a system component names itself.

actor.description: Who caused an event: a client session, routine, adapter or system component.

payload.description: The event's data; its shape belongs to the stream's workstream.

event.description: One event on the environment's log, as every stream carries it.

description: From the environment: one event of the subscription's stream. sequence equals event.sequence, a rule the decoder keeps and this schema cannot state.
